entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: Substate in EMM-DEREGISTERED state where the UE is searching for PLMNs.

entities.name: NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: Substate entered when a cell has been selected and normal service is available.

entities.name: LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: Substate entered when a cell has been selected but only limited service is available.

entities.name: NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: Substate entered when it has been concluded that no cell is available at the moment.

entities.name: Cell selected
entities.description: Condition where a cell has been selected by the UE.

entities.name: No cell available
entities.description: Condition where it has been concluded that no cell is available at the moment.

relations.description: When a cell is selected, the UE transitions to NORMAL-SERVICE substate.
When a cell is selected, the UE transitions to LIMITED-SERVICE substate.
When no cell is available, the UE transitions to NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substate.
PLMN-SEARCH substate is left when cell selection condition is met.
PLMN-SEARCH substate is left when no cell available condition is met.
